COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
FA No.97 of 2021
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Shobhit Saharia, Advocate for the 
appellant.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Admit the first appeal.
No notices are required to be sent to 
respondent nos.1, 2 & 3, who are already 
represented by Mr. Siddharth Singh, Advocate.
Let notices be issued to respondent nos.4 to 
7. The appellant would take steps within a period of 
one week from today to serve notices on the 
unserved respondents.
Summon the lower court’s record.
Till the next date of listing, parties to the 
appeal would maintain status quo qua the nature, 
title and possession of the property.
List after lower court’s record is received. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 15.11.2021
